description: Live non-custodial stablecoin liquidity, as positions an agent can actually trade against. Earn-worthy USDC/USDT maker positions: each row carries the strategy hash, network, pair, tokens and settled volume. Use this before a stablecoin swap to find a real on-chain counterparty, or to survey where stablecoin liquidity sits. Filter by network and by pair. Free, no key, no custody.

chain.description: Network key, e.g. "base" or "ethereum". Defaults to every network.

pair.description: Pair filter. Currently only the USDC/USDT stable pair is selectable.
